d: Long, straight lime-green hair with bangs frames a face of mature adulthood, featuring narrow, golden-amber eyes. The build is slender, draped in a voluminous, floor-length layered robe of cream, gold, and deep brown, complemented by a wide green collar that extends into wing-like flaps. Non-human traits include a golden ornate mask covering the upper face, large curved white horns, and a long, thick golden-brown scaled tail. BODY COLOR: Golden-brown LEGS: Plantigrade, hidden by robes
